concept.hr: Koliko podataka i koliko vremena gubite, na jednoj vremenskoj crti
concept.en: How much data and how much time you lose, on one timeline

summary.hr: Postavi kopije i incident na crtu: zadnja dobra kopija određuje izgubljene podatke, a otkrivanje, odluka, vraćanje i provjera vrijeme prekida.
summary.en: Place copies and an incident on a timeline: the last good copy sets the data lost; detection, decision, restore and verification the time down.

concept.hr: Kopija u 01:40, incident u 14:05: 12 h 25 min podataka i 6,5 h prekida
concept.en: A copy at 01:40, an incident at 14:05: 12 h 25 min of data, 6.5 h down

concept.hr: Kopija svake noći, a zadnja koja se vraća stara je 49 dana
concept.en: A copy every night, but the last one that restores is 49 days old

concept.hr: Samo otkrivanje traje 32,5 sata, cilj RTO promašen prije vraćanja
concept.en: Detection alone takes 32.5 hours; the RTO target is missed before any restore

concept.hr: Šifriranje nose replika i kopije poslije 02:10; vrijedi kopija od prije napada
concept.en: The replica and the copies after 02:10 carry the encryption; the 01:40 one works

concept.hr: Replikacija daje RPO 0 za kvar diska, a za brisanje nijednu točku oporavka
concept.en: Replication gives RPO 0 for a disk failure and no recovery point for a deletion
